blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: System One models such as Jev return decisions through fast, parallel prediction. In this paper, we introduce Jeveration, showing that the same decision paradigm can also generate high-quality images in a single forward pass. Jeveration builds on a frozen vision-language model, repurposing its visual-semantic knowledge for holistic image generation. The key challenge is to maintain global consistency. A single prompt admits many valid images, yet parallel predictions must converge on a coherent whole. We therefore condition all positions on a shared random state to coordinate parallel predictions, so that each draw yields a different but coherent image. Since the model tends to ignore this state under direct image supervision, we first learn a distribution over discrete image codes to guide single-pass generation. Beyond text-to-image generation, we further unify image-to-image generation and dense prediction within the same architecture, so that one checkpoint supports all three tasks, each in one forward pass. Experiments show that Jeveration generates a 512x512 image in 78 ms, up to 122x faster than existing unified models, while maintaining competitive image quality and dense prediction performance.
blocks.zh: 系统 一个模型,如Jev通过快速,平行的预测返回决定. 在本文中,我们介绍了Jeveration,表明同样的决定范式也可以在一次前传中产生高质量的图像. 耶稣会以冷冻的视觉语言模式为基础,重新运用其视觉语义知识来全面生成图像. 主要挑战是保持全球一致性。 单一的提示承认了许多有效的图像,但并行的预测必须一致地形成一个连贯的整体. 因此,我们把所有立场都建立在共同的随机状态上,以协调平行的预测,这样每一幅图都会产生不同但一致的形象。 由于模型倾向于在直接的图像监督下忽略这种状态,我们首先在离散的图像代码上学习分布,以引导单传生成. 除了文本到图像生成之外,我们进一步将图像到图像生成和密集的预测统一在同一架构内,这样,一个检查点就能支持所有三项任务,每个任务都通过一个前传. 实验显示,Jeveration在78ms中生成512x512图像,最高速度比现有的统一模型快122x,同时保持有竞争力的图像质量和密集的预测性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Image generation today is dominated by two paradigms. Autoregressive models [ 40 , 44 , 11 ] generate an image token by token, while diffusion models [ 8 , 48 , 25 ] generate it by iterative denoising. Both generally require many sequential model evaluations for a single image, which increases inference latency.
We introduce a third paradigm for image generation that removes sequential sampling, built on System One models. Our model, Jeveration, returns a complete image as one joint decision in a single forward pass, given a text prompt or a source image ( Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
今天的图像生成主要有两个范式. 自动递归型号[40,44,11]通过代号生成图像符号,而扩散型号[8,48,25]则通过迭代去诺来生成. 两者一般都要求对单一图像进行许多顺序模型评价,这增加了推论的延迟性.
我们引入了图像生成的第三个范式,取消了基于System One模型的连续抽样. 我们的模型 Jeveration 返回一个完整的图像,作为单一前传中的一项联合决定,给予文本提示或源图像(图1).

blocks.en: System One models such as Jev [ 1 ] return typed decisions, such as Choices or Scores, in a single parallel query without extended reasoning [ 1 ] . They have been applied to option selection, object localization, robot action scoring, and image evaluation [ 12 , 42 , 43 , 26 , 27 ] . Their effectiveness in these decision-making and understanding tasks draws in part on the visual and semantic knowledge acquired through large-scale pretraining. This knowledge also offers a foundation for image synthesis, suggesting that System One models have generative potential beyond their current uses. Motivated by this potential, we first explore a direct approach: using a System One model to select an entry from an existing codebook for every code position in a single forward pass. Our initial attempts, however, reveal two key challenges. First, direct parallel selection does not ensure global coherence. A single prompt admits many valid images, thus parallel decisions at different positions may correspond to incompatible realizations, producing image regions that fail to fit together, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . Second, extending this approach to diverse image generation tasks requires a unified architecture that accommodates different inputs and conditioning requirements.
blocks.zh: 系统 一个模型,如Jev [1] 回键决定,如Choices或Scores,在一个没有扩展推理的单一并行查询中 [1]. 已应用于选项选择、对象本地化、机器人动作评分和图像评价[12、42、43、26、27]。 它们在这些决策和理解任务中的有效性部分来自于通过大规模预训获得的视觉和语义知识. 这种知识也为图像合成提供了基础,认为System One模型在目前用途之外具有基因潜力. 基于这种潜力,我们首先探索一种直接的方法:使用一个系统一模型从现有的代码簿中为单个前传中的每一个代码位置选择一个条目. 然而,我们的初步努力揭示了两个主要挑战。 首先,直接的平行选择不能确保全球的一致性。 单一的提示承认许多有效的图像,因此不同位置的平行决定可能对应不兼容的实现,产生无法融合的图像区域,如图所示. 2 (英语). 第二,将这种方法推广到多种图像生成任务上,需要一种能够容纳不同投入和调制要求的统一架构.

blocks.en:
To keep the image globally consistent, we condition all positions on a shared random state that coordinates the parallel predictions, so that each draw yields a different but coherent image.
Furthermore, since a model trained on target images alone tends to ignore this state, we first train a model that learns the distribution of images as discrete codes, and then use it to judge the single-pass decisions and guide their training. The same paradigm extends to further tasks whose output is an image. Image-to-image generation uses a source image or visual conditions, such as edges, depth or grayscale, to guide the content and appearance of the generated image. Dense prediction can be regarded as image-to-image generation in a broad sense, where the model generates a map aligned with the input image that specifies a class, depth or surface normal at each pixel. One model can thus cover generation as well as perception.
blocks.zh:
为了保持全球图像的一致性,我们将所有位置以一个共享的随机状态作为条件,以协调平行的预测,这样每个绘图产生不同但一致的图像.
此外,由于一个只受过目标图像训练的模型往往忽略了这种状态,我们首先训练一个模型,学习图像作为离散代码的分布,然后用它来判断单传决定并指导他们的训练. 同样的范式还延伸到产出为图像的其他任务. 图像到图像生成使用源图像或视觉条件,如边缘,深度或灰度,来引导生成的图像的内容和外观. 感知预测可以看作是广义的图像到图像生成,模型生成一个与输入图像一致的地图,指定每个像素的类,深度或表面正常. 因此,一种模式可以涵盖生成和感知。

blocks.en:
Putting these together, Jeveration starts from a vision-language model (VLM), Qwen3.5-4B [ 41 ] , and lets it answer visual tasks with Jev-style decisions. The VLM stays frozen, and Jeveration adds only LoRA adapters [ 21 ] and output heads. Each answer, whether an image or a dense map, is one typed decision made in a single forward pass, and one checkpoint covers text-to-image generation, image-to-image generation and dense prediction tasks.
It reaches 0.74 GenEval at 512 px in 78 ms per image on one H200, 122 × \times faster than Janus-Pro-7B [ 11 ] , closely follows the input structure in image-to-image generation, and achieves competitive results on dense prediction.
These results show that a decision model itself can generate images and predict dense maps in a single forward pass. Our contributions are:

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Unified multimodal models combine image understanding and synthesis. Chameleon [ 40 ] , Emu3 [ 44 ] , Janus/Janus-Pro [ 45 , 11 ] and Unified-IO 2 [ 33 ] generate image tokens autoregressively. Show-o [ 49 ] uses masked prediction, while Transfusion [ 56 ] and BAGEL [ 14 ] model continuous image latents. MetaQueries [ 36 ] and BLIP3-o [ 9 ] instead connect understanding representations to separate diffusion generators. All of these models generate an image over many sequential steps, token by token or by iterative denoising. Dense prediction is another route to visual outputs. For instance, LENS [ 32 ] adds segmentation to a frozen multimodal model, while DenseMLLM [ 29 ] supervises visual tokens for dense prediction. In contrast, Jeveration unifies image synthesis and dense prediction by formulating both as parallel typed decisions, using a single frozen VLM with shared adapters and task-specific output heads.
blocks.zh: 统一的多式联运模型结合了图像理解和合成. 变色龙 [40], Emu3 [44], Janus/Janus-Pro [45, 11] 和 United-IO 2 [33] 自动生成图像符号. Show-o [49]使用蒙面预测,而输液[56]和BAGEL[14]模型连续图像潜伏. MetaQueries [36] 和 BLIP3-o [9] 转而将理解表达式连接到单独的扩散生成器. 所有这些模型都通过许多顺序步骤、代号或迭代代号生成一个图像。 感知预测是视觉输出的另一种途径. 例如,LENS [32]在冻结的多式联运模型中添加了分块,而DENSEMLLM [29] 监督视觉信号符进行密集预测。 与此相反,Jeveration将图像合成和密集预测统一起来,将两者编组为平行的打字决定,使用一个带有共享适配器和任务特定输出头的单一冷冻VLM.

blocks.en:
Single-pass generators learn to turn a random input into an image without iterative sampling. Consistency models [ 39 ] and MeanFlow [ 18 ] learn direct generation in continuous spaces. DMD/DMD2 [ 53 , 52 ] , SANA-Sprint [ 10 ] and TwinFlow [ 13 ] provide further approaches to one-step or few-step synthesis. Acceleration also applies to unified models. For example, Show-o Turbo [ 50 ] uses consistency distillation, and Omni-Diffusion-Distill [ 23 ] compresses multimodal decoding trajectories. For discrete images, MaskGIT [ 5 ] , Muse [ 6 ] and Meissonic [ 3 ] learn masked-code conditionals and sample over multiple rounds. Di[M]O [ 57 ] distills such a model into a one-step generator by matching its token-level conditionals with the help of an auxiliary model. Soft-Di[M]O [ 58 ] further uses soft embeddings to enable differentiable refinement.
Building on this line of work, Jeveration adapts token-level conditional matching to learn coherent image synthesis through the parallel typed decisions of a frozen VLM. Its target conditionals are provided by a masked model first trained on the same frozen backbone, while a confidence-guided correction target further guides parallel code selection.
blocks.zh:
单通道生成器学会了将随机输入转换成图像而不进行迭代采样. 一致性模型[39]和MeanFlow[18]在连续空间中学习直接生成. DMD/DMD2 [53, 52],SANA-Sprint [10]和双流[13]提供了一步或几步合成的进一步方法. 加速也适用于统一型号. 例如,Show-o Turbo [50] 采用一致性蒸馏法,Omni-diffusion-Distill [23]压缩多式联运解码轨迹. 对于离散图像,MaskGIT [5],Muse [6]和Meissonic [3]通过多轮学习蒙蔽码条件和样本. Di[M]O [57]通过在辅助模型的帮助下将它的符号级条件匹配,将这样的模型蒸馏成一个单步生成器. Soft-Di[M]O [58] 进一步使用软嵌入法来进行不同的改进.
在这条工作线上,Jeveration通过冷冻VLM的平行排版决定,调整了符号级的有条件匹配,以学习连贯的图像合成. 其目标条件由最初在同一个冷冻骨干上训练的蒙面模型提供,而信心导校正目标则进一步指导平行代码选择.

blocks.en: Jev [ 1 ] returns typed outputs such as Choices, Scores, and probabilities in parallel without generating lengthy text, while its Box interface predicts the four edges of an object’s bounding box [ 42 ] . Open decision models [ 12 , 19 , 2 ] and a clinical decision model [ 55 ] similarly provide structured decision outputs. Jeva [ 28 ] explicitly addresses candidate-set scalability, demonstrating full-set decision-making with up to 2,048 candidates in its evaluation. These decision interfaces also support specialized applications: Qwen-Audio-Jev [ 17 ] answers typed questions about audio, JevVLA [ 43 ] scores and corrects robot actions, and Visual Jev Rewards [ 26 ] evaluates generated images to reward a separate generator. Jeveration extends this paradigm to spatially coordinated image generation, predicting all image tokens in parallel within a single forward pass conditioned on a shared random state. The same model also predicts dense maps in one pass, using a class Choice at each position for segmentation and Scores for depth and surface normal estimation.
blocks.zh: Jev [ 1] 在不产生冗长文本的情况下, 返回并行的输入输出, 如 Choices, Scores, 和概率, 而它的 Box 接口则预测一个对象的边框的四边 [42] 。 开放式决策模型[12,19,2]和一个临床决策模型[55]同样提供结构化决策产出. Jeva [28]明确涉及候选人设置的可伸缩性,在其评价中显示最多有2 048名候选人的全面决策。 这些决定界面也支持专门的应用: Quen-Audio-Jev [17] 解答关于音频的打字问题, JevVLA [43] 得分和纠正机器人动作, Visual Jev Rewards [26] 评估生成的图像以奖励单独的生成器. Jeveration将这个范式扩展至空间协调的图像生成,在以共享随机状态为条件的单个前传中,以平行的方式预测所有图像符号. 同一模型还预测一个传中密度的地图,利用每个位置的类选择来进行分化,分数用于深度和表面正常估计.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Jeveration enables a VLM to generate images through parallel typed decisions in a single forward pass, while supporting dense prediction within the same framework. As shown in Fig. 3 , for image synthesis, these decisions select a codebook entry at each code position, while for dense prediction they produce task-specific classes or scores. A shared random state gives all code positions common stochastic conditioning, so that each draw yields a different but globally coherent image. We first formalize these visual decisions and the role of shared randomness ( Sec. 3.1 ). We then describe how a frozen VLM with shared adapters and task-specific output heads supports these tasks within one checkpoint ( Sec. 3.2 ). Finally, we present the training procedure that teaches the model to produce coherent images through parallel decisions ( Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: Jeveration使VLM能够通过单个前传的平行打字决定生成图像,同时支持在同一框架内的密集预测. 如图3所示,对于图像合成,这些决定在每个代码位置选择一个代码簿条目,而对于密集的预测,则产生任务特定类别或分数. 一个共享的随机状态让所有代码位置都具有共同的分层条件,这样,每个绘图产生不同但全球一致的图像. 我们首先将这些视觉决定和共享随机性的作用正式化(第3.1条)。 然后,我们描述一个带有共享适配器和特定任务产出头的冷冻VLM如何在一个检查站内支持这些任务(第3.2节)。 最后,我们介绍了培训程序,该程序通过并行决定,教导该模式产生一致的形象(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Architecture overview. A frozen vision-language model with shared LoRA adapters processes input and decision tokens in one forward pass. Decision tokens start from a random state for image generation, while for dense prediction they act as spatial queries. Task-specific heads then map their final hidden states to image codes or dense predictions. One checkpoint serves all tasks.

blocks.en: 3.1 Images as Decisions
blocks.zh: 3.1 将图像作为决定

blocks.en: Given a condition y y , which holds a prompt or an input image, Jeveration answers with typed decisions [ 1 ] . An image is a joint Choice of discrete codes c = ( c 1 , … , c N ) c=(c_{1},\ldots,c_{N}) of an image tokenizer, segmentation is a Choice over semantic classes at each spatial position, and depth and surface normals are real-valued Scores at every position. A dense map has one correct answer per input and is decided deterministically, whereas one prompt admits many valid images, so an image decision should be stochastic.

blocks.en: 3.2 Architecture and Inference

blocks.en:
We implement these visual decisions by appending decision tokens to the input of a VLM, as shown in Fig. 3 . Text tokens encode the prompt and task instruction, and a frozen vision tower encodes any input image into visual tokens. The decision tokens are initialised from a sampled random state for image generation and serve as spatial queries for dense prediction. A frozen Qwen3.5-4B [ 41 ] backbone with shared LoRA adapters [ 21 ] processes the input and decision tokens in a single forward pass. In its full-attention layers, decision tokens attend to each other bidirectionally while the input prefix remains causal. Finally, task-specific heads map the decision tokens’ final hidden states to image codes or dense predictions. The same checkpoint is used for
every task.

The image tokenizer is a frozen TA-TiTok [ 54 , 24 ] with N = 128 N=128 codes per image. For image generation, we append N N decision tokens, and the i i -th token decides the code c i c_{i} . The initial embeddings of these tokens encode the random state ξ ∼ p 0 \xi\sim p_{0} , which masks each position with probability ρ \rho , fills the remaining positions with uniformly random codes and adds Gaussian noise of scale σ \sigma to all embeddings. Following Di[M]O [ 57 ] , we set ρ = 0.6 \rho=0.6 and σ = 0.1 \sigma=0.1 . A transformer head [ 37 ] reads the final hidden states of these tokens together with ξ \xi and outputs a feature u i u_{i} for each position. We predict each code from u i u_{i} with two branches. The codebook branch f cb f_{\mathrm{cb}} projects u i u_{i} to the
code space and applies a classifier initialised from the tokenizer’s codebook.
The wide branch f wide f_{\mathrm{wide}} , initialised at zero, maps u i u_{i} directly to the code logits, giving the head more freedom to learn. The code distribution sums the two: q θ , i ( ⋅ ∣ y , ξ ) = softmax ( f cb ( u i ) + f wide ( u i ) ) . q_{\theta,i}(\cdot\mid y,\xi)=\operatorname{softmax}\big(f_{\mathrm{cb}}(u_{i})+f_{\mathrm{wide}}(u_{i})\big). (4) Both branches are trained and we conduct ablations in Sec. 4.4 to show the benefit of combining them. At inference, all codes are sampled in parallel as one joint decision.
Finally, they are rendered by the tokenizer’s decoder, which also reads the prompt and which we fine-tune for 512-px output. For image-to-image generation, a gated branch also feeds the source image to the decoder.

We train the model to use ξ \xi to make coherent image decisions. Direct supervision on target codes does not encourage the model to use ξ \xi , since the random state is sampled independently of the target image.
We therefore first learn a model of the image distribution through masked prediction, then use it to guide image decisions from random states.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
All main results use the same Jeveration checkpoint. Generation training combines FLUX-Reason-6M images [ 16 ] and Qwen-Image [ 46 ] renderings of text-to-image-2M prompts [ 59 ] .
Image-to-image training uses derived conditions and synthetic style pairs, while dense tasks use NYUv2 [ 38 ] . We train rank-256 LoRA adapters for about 92k steps in the first phase and 6.7k in the second, which take about four days on a single machine with four NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPUs.

图像到图像训练使用衍生条件和合成风格对,而密集的任务使用NYUv2[38]. 我们在第一阶段对256 LoRA适配器进行约92k级的训练,在第二阶段对6.7k级的训练,这需要大约4天的单机使用4台NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU.

blocks.en:
We evaluate text-to-image generation with GenEval [ 20 ] , DPG-Bench [ 22 ] and HPSv2.1 [ 47 ] .
Image-to-image outputs are scored by how well they follow the input structure, using edge F1 or depth accuracy. Stylized outputs are compared with paired targets by PSNR. Dense prediction uses the standard NYUv2 metrics. Latency is the median of five end-to-end calls on one H200 at batch 1.

blocks.en: Jeveration produces visually coherent images with detailed textures across natural scenes, portraits, objects and artistic styles ( Figs. 1 and 4 ). The samples capture both the requested content and appearance, from the dragon inside a teacup to the stained-glass phoenix. In one forward pass, it generates a 512 × 512 512{\times}512 image in 77.8 ms end to end on one H200, the fastest in Tab. 1 , and reaches 0.74 GenEval.
blocks.zh: Jeveration 制作了视觉上连贯的图像,其中包含跨越自然场景的详细纹理,肖像,物品和艺术风格(图1和图4). 样本既捕捉了所要求的内容,也捕捉了外观,从茶杯内的龙到污玻璃凤凰. 在一次前传中,它生成一个512×512 512\Times}512图像在77.8 ms中结束到一个H200上,这是Tab中最快的. 1,并达到0.74 GenEval.

blocks.en: Among unified models, Jeveration is the fastest and achieves higher GenEval and HPSv2.1 than JanusFlow, Show-o, Show-o Turbo, MMaDA and Janus-Pro-1B. At the same 512-px resolution, it improves GenEval by 0.11 over four-step Show-o Turbo-512 while reducing latency from 94.1 to 77.8 ms. Compared with the autoregressive Janus-Pro-1B and Janus-Pro-7B, it is 98 × 98\times and 122 × 122\times faster.
blocks.zh: 在统一的模型中,Jeveration是最快的,并且比JanusFlow,Show-o,Show-o Turbo,MMADA和Janus-Pro-1B取得了更高的GenEval和HPSv2.1. 在同样的512px分辨率下,它在四步Show-o Turbo-512上改进了GenEval0.11,同时将纬度从94.1米降低到77.8米. 与自递式的Janus-Pro-1B和Janus-Pro-7B相比,其速度是98×98\时,122×122\时.

blocks.en: Compared with generation-only models, Jeveration achieves higher GenEval than the multi-step models at the same 512-px resolution (0.74 versus 0.49 to 0.65) while being 5 to 8 times faster. It also achieves higher GenEval than SANA-Sprint 0.6B, FLUX.1-schnell and SDXL-DMD2, one-step models that generate 1024-px images. These results show that a frozen VLM can generate images of competitive quality in one forward pass.

blocks.en: 4.3 Image-to-Image and Dense Prediction
blocks.zh: 4.3 图像到图像和传感器预测

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 5 , the same checkpoint handles many image-to-image tasks.
It can turn edge maps and depth maps into realistic images, colorize grayscale photos, and render photos in anime, Studio Ghibli and watercolor styles. Jeveration achieves strong structural fidelity, with 0.880 HED edge F1, 0.802 depth δ 1 \delta_{1} and 0.937 colorization edge F1 on held-out examples ( Tab. 2 ). Within this structure, the text prompt guides the content and appearance. Notably, this control comes at almost no extra cost, since each request is still a single forward pass of 91.7 ms, only 14 ms more than text-to-image generation. These results show that controllable generation is possible in one forward pass, without iterative sampling.
blocks.zh:
如图5所示,同一检查站处理许多图像到图像的任务。
它可以将边缘地图和深度地图转换成现实的图像,将灰度照片染色,并以动画, Studio Ghibli和水彩风格渲染照片. 热能实现强大的结构忠贞性,有0.880 HED边缘F1,0.802深度δ1\delta_{1}和0.937色化边缘F1在被搁置的例子上(Tab. 2 ). 在这个结构内,文字提示指导内容和外观. 值得注意的是,这种控制几乎不需要额外的费用,因为每项请求仍然是91.7毫秒的单一前传,仅比文本到图像生成多14毫秒。 这些结果显示,在一次前传中可以进行可控生成,而无需反复取样.

blocks.en: The same checkpoint is also a strong dense predictor ( Fig. 6 ). As shown in Tab. 3 , it reaches 67.7 mIoU on NYUv2, on par with dense-only models trained from the same backbone (67.8 and 67.3), and significantly outperforms DeepLabV3+, with 14.2 higher mIoU and a 32% lower depth error (0.267 versus 0.393 m). Each prediction takes a single forward pass of about 78 ms. Surface normals lag behind, likely because fine local geometry is the most sensitive to sharing capacity across tasks. These results demonstrate that a single checkpoint can serve both image generation and dense prediction.
blocks.zh: 同一检查站也是一个强烈的密集预测器(图6)。 如Tab. 3所示,NYUv2上的MIoU达到67.7 mIoU,与同一主干(67.8和67.3)培训的仅密集型号相当,并且明显超过DeepLabV3+,mIoU更高14.2 mIoU,深度差差32%(0.267对0.393米)。 每一次预测都有一个约78毫秒的单个前传. 表面常态落后,可能是因为精细的局部几何对跨任务共享能力最为敏感. 这些结果表明,一个单一的检查站既能产生图像,也能提供密集的预测。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: The shared random state lets all positions follow one image, while different states give different images. Decision training teaches the model to use this state. Without it, the first-phase masked model reaches only 0.32 GenEval in one pass ( Fig. 2 ). With a fixed state instead of a random one, HPSv2.1 drops from 28.27 to 26.63 and GenEval from 0.73 to 0.70 ( Tab. 4 ). The randomness of the shared state thus makes the images more coherent and of higher quality.
blocks.zh: 共享的随机状态让所有位置遵循一个图像,而不同的状态给出不同的图像. 决策训练教模型使用这种状态. 没有它,第一级蒙面模型在一次通过(图2)中只达到0.32 GenEval. 以固定状态而非随机状态,HPSv2.1从28.27降至26.63,GenEval从0.73降至0.70(Tab. 4). 因此,共享状态的随机性使得图像更加连贯,质量更高.

blocks.en: Table 4 : Ablation studies. Each block is a separate experiment that changes one component, so values are comparable only within a block. From top to bottom, the blocks start from a text-to-image-only model, an earlier run on all tasks and the first-phase masked model. Highlighted rows are the settings Jeveration uses.
blocks.zh: 表4:读物研究。 每个块是一个单独的实验,可以改变一个组件,因此数值只有在块内是可比的. 从上到下,区块从文本到图像的仅限模式开始,早期运行于所有任务和一级遮盖模式. 突出的行是 Jeveration 使用的设置.

blocks.en: The correction target brings a further gain in image quality, as removing it lowers HPSv2.1 from 28.03 to 27.92 at similar GenEval ( Tab. 4 ). This suggests that distribution matching already determines the composition, while the correction refines details.
blocks.zh: 校正目标为图像质量带来进一步的增益,因为它在类似的GenEval(Tab. 4)中将其从28.03降低到27.92. 这表明分布匹配已经决定了构成,而修正则细化细节.

blocks.en: In the first-phase masked model, the two branches together outperform either branch alone, with 0.64 GenEval against 0.60 and 0.59 for the wide and codebook branches ( Tab. 4 ). We hypothesize that they are complementary, as the codebook branch inherits the structure of the tokenizer’s codebook while the wide branch adds capacity beyond this structure.
blocks.zh: 在第一阶段的蒙面模型中,两个分支加起来的性能单于任何一个分支,0.64 GenEval对0.60和0.59对宽和密码本分支(Tab. 4). 我们假设它们是互补的,因为代码簿分支继承了代号器代码簿的结构,而宽分支则增加了超出这个结构的能力。

blocks.en: Both the generated codes and the source image are essential for image-to-image generation. Even without the source, the decoder recovers most of the input structure from the codes alone (0.792 HED edge F1 and 0.767 depth δ 1 \delta_{1} ), indicating that the VLM transfers the input layout into its decisions. Feeding the source image to the decoder brings further improvements, raising HED edge F1 to 0.880 and colorization edge F1 from 0.757 to 0.937 ( Tab. 2 ). This suggests that the 128 codes capture the global structure, while the source image supplies the fine details.
blocks.zh: 生成的代码和源图像对图像到图像生成都是必不可少的. 即使没有源代码,解码器也只从代码中恢复了大部分输入结构(0.792 HED边缘F1和0.767深度δ1\delta_{1}),表明VLM将输入布局转移到其决定中. 将源图像输入解码器带来进一步的改进,将HED边缘F1提高到0.880,将色化边缘F1从0.757提高到0.937(Tab. 2 ). 这表明128代码捕捉到全球结构,而源图像则提供精细的细节.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Joint training across tasks. Training on all tasks costs almost no text-to-image quality. Both models get about the same amount of text-to-image training, so the difference comes from adding image-to-image and dense tasks.
blocks.zh: 表5:跨任务联合培训。 关于所有任务的培训几乎没有文字到图像的质量。 两个模型都得到了大约相同数量的文字对图像训练,所以区别来自于增加图像对图像和密集的任务.

blocks.en: Joint training extends the model to image-to-image generation and dense prediction at almost no cost to text-to-image quality. As shown in Tab. 5 , Jeveration performs on par with a model trained only on text-to-image, with comparable GenEval (0.74 versus 0.73), HPSv2.1 (28.06 versus 28.28) and DPG (78.24 versus 78.61). For dense prediction, it matches dense-only models in segmentation, with only a modest drop in depth and normal accuracy ( Tab. 3 ). This demonstrates that a single set of adapters on a frozen VLM can accommodate diverse visual tasks with little interference.
blocks.zh: 联合训练将模型扩展至图像到图像生成和密集的预测,对文本到图像的质量几乎没有成本. 如塔布所示. 5, Jeveration 与只受过文字到图像培训的模型相同,具有类似的GenEval(0.74对0.73)、HPSv2.1(28.06对28.28)和DPG(78.24对78.61)。 对于密集的预测,它匹配分解中仅密集的模型,深度和正常精度只有适度下降(Tab. 3). 这表明,在冷冻的VLM上,一个单一的一组适配器可以容纳不同的视觉任务,而很少干扰.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Jeveration introduces a third paradigm for image generation, in which a System One model returns a whole image as one joint decision in a single forward pass. Built on a frozen VLM, it conditions all code positions on a shared random state to encourage global consistency, while a masked model trained beforehand provides the target conditional distributions for parallel code prediction. One checkpoint performs text-to-image generation, image-to-image generation and dense prediction, and joint training across tasks comes at almost no cost to text-to-image quality. Jeveration generates 512-px images in 78 ms on a single H200, achieves strong structural fidelity in image-to-image generation, and delivers segmentation performance comparable to dense-only models. We expect this paradigm to extend to further visual tasks and modalities.
blocks.zh: Jeveration引入了图像生成的第三个范式,其中一个System One模型将整个图像作为单个前传中的联合决定返回. 它以冻结的VLM为基础,在共享随机状态上将所有代码位置作为条件,以鼓励全球一致性,而事先训练的蒙面模型则为平行代码预测提供了目标有条件的分布. 一个检查站进行文字到图像生成、图像到图像生成和密集预测,跨任务的联合培训几乎不花文字到图像的质量。 Jeveration在单H200上以78ms生成512-px图像,在图像到图像生成中实现强大的结构忠心,并提供可与稠密唯物模型相比的分解性能. 我们期望这一模式将扩大到进一步的视觉任务和模式。

blocks.en: Jeveration keeps the Qwen3.5-4B backbone and its vision tower frozen. All tasks share rank-256 LoRA adapters, and task-specific heads read the decision tokens. Image generation uses 128 TA-TiTok codes from an 8,192-entry codebook, and dense prediction uses 432 spatial queries. About 1.0B parameters are trainable in total, including the adapters, input modules and output heads.
